# HQ Commands

<!-- Generated by core/scripts/skill-inventory.sh --markdown --scope shipped. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every release-shipped HQ skill and slash command, grouped by the job it does.
The same data is published as [commands.json](commands.json) for the desktop command palette.
Regenerate both files with `bash core/scripts/skill-inventory.sh --json --scope shipped --out core/docs/hq/commands.json`
and `bash core/scripts/skill-inventory.sh --markdown --scope shipped --out core/docs/hq/COMMANDS.md`.

Grouping rule: a skill takes the first group below whose keywords match a word in its name;
if none match, the first group whose keywords match a word in its description; otherwise "other".

- **session state**: handoff, checkpoint, resume, resumework, startwork, journal, session, sessions, recover, pin, compact, conduct
- **sync**: sync, conflict, conflicts, update, promote, backmerge
- **share**: share, dm, broadcast, message, messages, invite, delegate, publish, slack, access, grant, grants
- **ship**: land, ship, deploy, release, execute, pipeline, review, quality, tdd, test, tests, merge, commit, worktree, investigate, diagnose, pr
- **plan**: plan, prd, brainstorm, strategize, ideate, idea, grill, grilling, architect, design, wayfinder, estimate, goals, tickets, roadmap
- **capture**: capture, learn, meeting, notes, signals, record, import, discover, ontology, knowledge, interview

## Session state

| Command | Scope | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/checkpoint` | core | Save a lightweight session checkpoint. |
| `/conduct` | core | Orchestrator mode: route multi-step work to in-session background subagents (default) or hq worker lanes. Triggers: /conduct, run everything in the background. |
| `/conduct-join` | core | Join this already-running session to a /conduct session as one of its children, so the conductor can send it instructions and receive its reports. Use when the user says "/conduct-join <link>", "join the conductor", "report to the conduct session", or pastes a link id that starts with "cl-". Also handles "leave" to detach. |
| `/core:work-mesh` | package | Work Mesh Live — automatic presence via hq mesh daemon; context reconcile/organize; manual session task-status, blocked, and note only. |
| `/daily-brief` | core | Build the user's Daily Brief across personal work and every permitted company. Reads the last brief and the user's brief preferences, sweeps sessions, PRs, CI and DMs (plus meeting signals, fleet and connected integrations when a company is bound), writes brief-data.json and brief.json with a launch prompt for every action, and reports status so the desktop app can notify the user. The person's first ready brief adds a welcome edition. Run by the main local bot when the user presses Create brief, or on a schedule. |
| `/handoff` | core | Preserve session state for a follow-up agent with handoff files and commits. |
| `/handoff-all` | core | Tell every open Claude Code desktop session to run /handoff, then collect each session's /resumework command. Triggers: \"handoff all sessions\", \"wrap up every session\". |
| `/hq-bug` | core | Submit HQ bug reports or feature requests with session context. |
| `/hq-heal` | core | Triage and repair HQ session errors such as hook crashes, sync conflicts, or MCP failures. |
| `/hq-whoami` | core | Show current HQ Cognito identity and session expiry. |
| `/journal` | core | Write structured session journal entries for durable working memory. |
| `/overnight` | core | Overnight team-comms mode inside a running /super-conductor session. On the conductor's heartbeat (at the away interval) it reads the HQ DM inbox and the active company's DM channels, answers information requests from HQ knowledge, routes work requests to the conducted child that owns them, queues anything only the owner can decide, checks that every teammate who asked for something got an answer or a route, and logs it all to the link's overnight report. Use when the user says "/overnight", "watch the team overnight", "handle team DMs while I sleep", "overnight mode", or "triage the inbox until morning". |
| `/pin` | core | Anchor this session to one goal — the message, target, or outcome it keeps working toward across loops, wakeups, compactions, and hand-offs — and check progress against it. |
| `/recover-session` | core | Recover sessions that hit context limits without a handoff. |
| `/resume-all` | core | Relaunch every session from a /handoff-all batch as a new Claude Code desktop session running its /resumework command. Triggers: \"resume all sessions\", \"bring back the handed-off sessions\". |
| `/resumework` | core | Resume a specific handoff thread by id. For the latest handoff use /startwork. |
| `/retro` | core | Run a project or session retrospective and capture reusable lessons. |
| `/startwork` | core | Resolve current HQ context and surface useful next work options. |
| `/super-conductor` | core | Become the standing conductor for everything live. Adopt every open Claude Code desktop session onto one conduct link, watch team comms (HQ DM inbox and DM channels) for requests, resolve collisions between sessions, and keep a persistent heartbeat that wakes it on a chosen interval (1, 5, 10 minutes, ...) to sweep the channels the owner picked (sessions, HQ DMs, Slack, email, X) until told to stop. Use when the user says "/super-conductor", "/conduct-all" (deprecated alias), "manage all my sessions", "watch everything while I'm away", "going to bed, manage open sessions and the team", or "conduct everything". |

## Sync

| Command | Scope | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/designate-team` | core | Mark a company as HQ Pro cloud-backed and sync its team setup. |
| `/hq-integrations` | core | Use the company's connected external apps (Linear, Notion, Jira, GitHub, Slack, Sentry, Gmail, Google Drive, Asana, ClickUp, Figma, HubSpot, Salesforce, and anything else wired through `hq integrations`) BEFORE reaching for a separate MCP, a web search, or asking the user. Trigger on any request to look up, read, create, update, or search in an external app, including natural phrasings like 'check my Linear tickets', 'open issues assigned to me', 'find the Notion doc about X', 'any new Sentry errors', 'my Jira issues', 'search Slack for', 'create a GitHub issue', 'add a task in Asana'. Check the SessionStart note 'HQ Integrations you can use in company <slug>' or run `hq integrations list --usable` first; only fall back to another path when no usable app covers it. Also covers connecting, sharing, policy, approval, and disconnect flows. |
| `/hq-pack-cowork:hq-cowork-files` | package | Browse or read HQ vault files from Cowork without a full sync. |
| `/hq-pack-cowork:hq-cowork-sync` | package | Run bidirectional HQ Sync from Cowork. |
| `/hq-sync` | core | Run a full bidirectional sync for cloud-backed HQ companies. |
| `/promote` | core | Change an HQ company member role or guest path scope. |
| `/registry` | core | Inspect or update a company resource registry around resource changes. |
| `/resolve-conflicts` | core | Resolve HQ Sync conflicts by choosing local, cloud, or discard. |
| `/sync-registry` | core | Rebuild a company resource registry index. |
| `/update-hq` | core | Upgrade HQ from the latest hq-core release. |

## Share

| Command | Scope | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/delegate` | core | Hand a project to a person or fleet agent: grants, dossier, ownership transfer, and a pickup DM. |
| `/dm` | core | Send or read HQ Sync direct messages — inbox, 1:1 threads, channel history; also prompts, details, or scheduled notes to teammates. |
| `/dm-bind` | core | Bind this session to one HQ DM channel — post structured status updates there and listen for replies (feedback, requests) that steer the work. |
| `/hq-access` | core | Diagnose and fix a vault file you cannot find or open — never existed, not synced (fetch and pin it), or no access (ask the owner with a one-click grant DM). |
| `/hq-files` | core | Inspect or change HQ vault ACLs, grants, and shared prefixes. |
| `/hq-pack-cowork:hq-cowork-dm` | package | Send HQ Sync direct messages from Cowork through the host-side DM tool. |
| `/hq-pack-cowork:hq-cowork-share` | package | Share HQ vault paths from Cowork through links or direct grants. |
| `/hq-share` | core | Share HQ vault paths through single-use links or direct ACL grants. |
| `/new-hire` | core | Onboard a teammate end to end: invite, role, groups, secrets, file access, and onboarding packet. Also brings existing access up to role. |
| `/newcompany` | core | Scaffold a new HQ company, optionally through to operational: knowledge, workers, brand, integrations, access rules, and invites. |
| `/publish-docs` | core | Sync the company's published docs site to match what shipped. For in-repo docs use /document-release. |
| `/schedule` | core | Schedule recurring Claude/Codex agent jobs on the user's Outpost — structured checklist requirements, dm alert profile, status-aware list from hq-pro. Alias: /job (deprecated). |
| `/team-access` | core | Set, change, or repair members' default read/write access to company vault folders, and find rules that lock members out. |
| `/work-broadcast` | core | Draft Slack broadcasts for completed or proposed HQ work. |

## Ship

| Command | Scope | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/clean-worktree` | core | Merge an HQ worktree branch back into local main, then remove the worktree and branch. Local only; never pushes. |
| `/commit-main` | core | Commit every dirty file in the current repo, only when on main. |
| `/deploy` | core | Deploy or share generated HQ artifacts through hq-deploy. |
| `/diagnose` | core | Diagnosis loop for bugs you cannot reliably reproduce or measure, including perf regressions and flakes. For reproducible bugs use /investigate. |
| `/document-release` | core | Update in-repo docs (README, CLAUDE.md, architecture, INDEX) to match what shipped. Use after a merge, project, or release. |
| `/execute-task` | core | Execute one PRD story through coordinated worker phases with test, lint, and typecheck gates. |
| `/hq-pack-cowork:hq-cowork-install` | package | Build and install the HQ Cowork plugin artifact and smoke-test it. |
| `/investigate` | core | Root-cause debugging before any fix: scope lock, hypothesis testing, debug report. Triggers: \"debug this\", \"why is this broken\". |
| `/land` | core | Land a PR: watch CI, resolve review issues, merge, verify production. Triggers: \"land this\", \"merge and monitor\". |
| `/land-batch` | core | Triage, review, and merge several open PRs in order, with CI and deploy checks. Triggers: \"land all PRs\", \"merge open PRs\". |
| `/orchestrate` | core | Take an idea to a finished deliverable: brainstorm, PRD, then execute every story. --gated pauses at decisions; --plan-only stops at the PRD. |
| `/outpost-host` | core | Host an app on this HQ Outpost/EC2 VM behind nginx and return its public URL. Refuses to run elsewhere. For artifacts use /deploy. |
| `/project-summary` | core | Render a branded visual artifact from a project's prd.json (plan summary) or brainstorm.md (research deck) and deploy it gated, returning a link. |
| `/quality-gate` | core | Universal pre-commit quality checks (typecheck, lint, test, coverage, dead code) with auto-detection and --fix support |
| `/review` | core | Pre-landing code review of the git diff; critical issues block the PR. Use before a PR or when asked to review changes. |
| `/review-plan` | core | Stress-test a plan or PRD in expansion, hold, or reduction mode. |
| `/run-pipeline` | core | Multi-project pipeline orchestrator — triage, execute, PR, review, deploy with safety gates |
| `/run-project` | core | Execute a project's PRD stories through HQ worker lanes that survive compaction. Interactive mode runs in the parent. |
| `/ship` | core | Take PRs through review, merge, deploy, smoke test, and monitoring until every KPI is healthy. Triggers: \"ship this\", \"take this to prod\". |
| `/tdd` | core | Enforce test-driven development with RED→GREEN→REFACTOR cycle and coverage validation |
| `/worktree` | core | Create a git worktree under workspace/worktrees/ off the latest origin default branch and route all work through it. |

## Plan

| Command | Scope | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/architect` | core | Find shallow modules and propose deepening refactors, ranked with file refs; never edits code. Use when code is hard to change or planning a refactor. |
| `/brainstorm` | core | Compare approaches to best-in-class prior art, merge existing work, verify cruft removal, and recommend the most durable design before PRD work. |
| `/calibration-report` | core | Summarize estimate accuracy from the assistant time log. |
| `/codebase-design` | core | Vocabulary for designing deep modules and clean interfaces. Triggers: \"deep module\", \"interface design\", \"design it twice\". |
| `/deep-plan` | core | Deep planning: research subagents plus a 15-question interview for large or strategic PRDs. For light planning use /prd. |
| `/finish-estimate` | core | Mark a pending time estimate complete with actual duration. |
| `/goals` | core | View and manage company OKRs and key results. |
| `/grill-me` | core | Interview the user about any topic one question at a time, using the grilling engine with a question set generated from the prompt. Use for "grill me on X" outside of planning. Pass --rounds for batched rounds. |
| `/grilling` | core | Shared interview engine for /brainstorm, /prd, and grill-me. Asks only the open frontier of a question set, looks up facts instead of asking them, and returns a question count. Engine only; not invoked on its own. |
| `/idea` | core | Capture a lightweight project idea on the board. |
| `/prd` | core | Create an execution-ready PRD (prd.json + README.md) with a light interview. For deep research use /deep-plan. |
| `/storyboard` | core | Lock visual design before building — explore mockups on your preferred surface (Paper, HTML, Figma) and feed discovered changes back into the PRD. |
| `/strategize` | core | Prioritize what to work on next, optionally with deep review. |
| `/to-tickets` | core | Break a plan or PRD into vertical-slice tickets with dependency order. Triggers: \"break into tickets\", \"vertical slices\". |
| `/track-estimate` | core | Manually log a time estimate. |
| `/wayfinder` | core | Plan work too big and foggy for one session as a map of investigation tickets resolved one per session. |

| `/adr` | core | Capture qualifying architecture decisions as ADRs in the right HQ or repo location. |

| `/hq-pack-cowork:hq-cowork` | package | Discover and dispatch HQ capabilities from a sandboxed Cowork plugin host. |
| `/hq-pack-cowork:hq-cowork-meetings` | package | Read HQ meeting notes and extracted signals from Cowork. |
| `/import-claude` | core | Deprecated alias for /import-context — bootstrap HQ from your prior AI footprint (Claude Code, Codex, Grok, claude.ai history plus on-disk artifacts). |
| `/import-context` | core | Bootstrap HQ from prior Claude Code, Codex, Grok, and claude.ai history and on-disk artifacts, with guided import. |
| `/join-meeting` | core | Ride a live meeting transcript in this session. Pick a live meeting or invite the bot with a join link, stay bound until it ends, then save the transcript. |
| `/knowledge-pulse` | core | Run a lightweight freshness pass over company knowledge and policies. |
| `/learn` | core | Turn reusable findings into scoped policies or insight files. |
| `/meeting-notes` | core | Read HQ-native meeting notes, transcripts, recaps, and sources for a company. |
| `/newworker` | core | Scaffold a new HQ worker with skills, tools, and knowledge. |
| `/ontology` | core | Read a company ontology brief, entity graph, and freshness signals for context. |
| `/out-of-scope` | core | Record rejected ideas so future planning does not revisit them. |
| `/personal-interview` | core | Build the owner profile and social voice through interview. |
| `/signals` | core | Read HQ-native company signals such as decisions, actions, risks, commitments, and wins. |

| `/hq-logout` | core | Sign out of HQ Cognito and clear local tokens. |

| `/hq-pack-cowork:hq-cowork-search` | package | Search HQ content from Cowork with full-text, semantic, or hybrid modes. |
| `/hq-pack-cowork:hq-cowork-secrets` | package | Run commands with HQ secrets from Cowork without exposing values. |
| `/hq-secrets` | core | Use HQ CLI secrets safely through env injection or one-off exec. |
| `/humanize` | core | Revise human-facing prose to remove AI tells and match the intended voice. |
| `/job` | core | Deprecated alias for /schedule — Outpost recurring agent jobs. Prefer /schedule. |

| `/onboard` | core | Create or join an HQ company through onboarding. |
| `/run` | core | Run or list HQ workers, preferring isolated Codex subagents when available. |
| `/search` | core | Search HQ content and indexed repos with qmd, falling back to grep. |
| `/setup` | core | Run the HQ Starter Kit setup wizard. |
| `/tutorial` | core | Run hands-on HQ workflow lessons. |

## Duplicate findings

- Exact duplicates (same name (case-insensitive), identical SKILL.md bytes, different source path): 0
- Drifted copies (same name (case-insensitive), different SKILL.md bytes): 0
- Near-duplicate descriptions (different names, description token Jaccard >= 0.5 (tokens: lowercase [a-z0-9]+ of 3+ chars minus stopwords; both sets >= 4 tokens)): 2

Details are in `findings` in commands.json, or run `bash core/scripts/skill-inventory.sh --findings`.
